description: Turn one organizer photo into a before-and-after video of a messy drawer, shelf or closet turning neat. Tall 9:16 clips for TikTok and Reels.
h1: Home Product Videos That Show the Reset
lead: Pick an organizing scene and add one photo. A messy drawer, shelf, or closet turns neat. Add a voice and captions if you want them.
steps_h2: How to Make a Storage Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: One organizer photo, a short line about the tidy-up, then a file you can post.

steps.d: Show the full organizer, including edges and compartments. Use even light so the shape is easy to judge.
Name the drawer, shelf, closet, or desk, and the one tidy-up. Then pick a size and a length.
Add a voice and captions, then post the tidy-up. Keep how much it holds in text you can edit.

faq.q: What is a home product video template?
faq.a: A ready scene that shows one organizer solving one storage task. You add a photo of the product. The clip shows that spot turning neat, with a voice and captions if you want them.

faq.q: How do I make the organizing clip?
faq.a: Upload the organizer photo, or paste the product link. Name the spot and the one change. Pick a size and a length. Add a voice or captions, then download or post.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of filming in a home?
faq.a: The tidy-up is made from the organizer photo you already have. You do not need a customer's home, a crew, or a new shoot.
Home and storage sellers who need a drawer, pantry, closet, or desk result for a social post, a product page, or an ad.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Show the full organizer and name one tidy-up. Check that the product shape still matches the photo.
One clear photo of the full organizer, including its edges, compartments, and surface. A public product link works when that page already shows the product.

faq.q: What does the clip actually show?
faq.a: One storage task in a drawer, on a shelf, in a closet, or on a desk. It is a single tidy-up, not a tour of the whole house. A person on screen is an AI presenter, not a real customer.

faq.q: Which size can I pick, and where can I post it?
faq.a: Pick one size: tall 9:16, square 1:1, wide 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. 4:3 is a shorter wide size, and 3:4 is a little taller than a square. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Send the file to TikTok, or to Meta (Facebook and Instagram), from your account. You can also download it. You see the credit cost before it starts.
A clip uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Credits are the balance on your monthly plan. If the clip fails, those credits come back. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Can I add sizes, and can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. Add sizes, how much it holds, names, and prices as captions, or as text after you download. The file has no AIVideosUGC watermark, so our name is not stamped on it. It can run in product pages and paid ads.

faq.q: Can I do several rooms, switch language, or use the API?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the organizer photo for another room. That can be a batch. You can switch the spoken line and captions to another language. The API lets your own software send the photos. Each one shows its credit cost first.

steps.prompt: A hand slides this dark gray adjustable divider tray into an open kitchen drawer. The camera looks down and follows the tray in one slow move. Bright window light shows the gray compartments. The last shot shows the full tray fitted in the drawer. You hear the drawer slide and a light utensil clink. Add background music if you want it. Keep the tray's shape, color, and label as in your photo.
